name: nRF52 Adafruit Bootloader BLE Updates
description: The `adafruit_ble` OTA platform updates [nRF52](https://esphome.io/components/nrf52/) boards that run the [Adafruit nRF52 Bootloader](https://github.com/adafruit/Adafruit_nRF52_Bootloader), such as the nice!nano, the ItsyBitsy nRF52840 and the Feather nRF52840, over Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) with `esphome upload`. For boards with MCUboot, use [zephyr_mcumgr](https://esphome.io/components/ota/zephyr_mcumgr/) instead.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.
